gaps.sentence: "We are leaving now." — They said they ___ then.
'I've been studying all night,' she said. She said she ___ studying all night.
gaps.hint: present perfect continuous → past perfect continuous
gaps.explanation: have been + -ing backshifts to had been + -ing.

gaps.sentence: 'I didn't take your charger,' she insisted. She ___ taking my charger.
gaps.explanation: Denials are reported as deny + -ing: denied taking.

gaps.sentence: 'Where will you be staying?' they asked. They asked where ___ be staying.
gaps.hint: future continuous backshift in a question
gaps.explanation: will you be staying → I would be staying: statement order, would for will.

gaps.sentence: 'Don't touch the thermostat,' the technician warned us. The technician warned us ___ the thermostat.
gaps.explanation: Negative commands are reported with 'warned + object + not to + infinitive'.

gaps.sentence: 'Don't be late again,' the coach told him. The coach told him ___ late again.
gaps.explanation: Negative commands: not to be, with the negative before the whole infinitive.

gaps.sentence: 'No, I won't open the door,' he said. He ___ to open the door.
gaps.explanation: Refusals are reported with refuse + to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: 'Well done, you've passed!' the examiner said. The examiner ___ me on passing.
